topPlaces.name: Kanheri Caves
topPlaces.description: The Kanheri Caves (Kānherī-guhā [kaːnʱeɾiː ɡuɦaː]) are a group of caves and rock-cut monuments, cut into a massive basalt outcrop in the forests of the Sanjay Gandhi National Park, on the island of Salsette in the western outskirts of Mumbai, India. They contain Buddhist sculptures and relief carvings, paintings and inscriptions, dating from the 1st century CE to the 10th century CE. Kanheri comes from the Sanskrit Krishnagiri, which means "black mountain".

image.alt: Grand panoramic view of the ancient rock-cut Kanheri Caves nestled in green basalt hills

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Sanjay Gandhi National Park?
faq.a: The best time to visit Sanjay Gandhi National Park is Oct – Mar. Summers are 26–40°C and winters are 12–28°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Sanjay Gandhi National Park?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Sanjay Gandhi National Park / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Kalyan Junction (Mumbai) (22 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Sanjay Gandhi National Park?
faq.a: 3 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Sanjay Gandhi National Park at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Sanjay Gandhi National Park?
faq.a: Stays in Sanjay Gandhi National Park start from ₹2,500 per night, with options across 5 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Sanjay Gandhi National Park?
faq.a: The top attractions are Kashigaon, St. Jerome Church (Kashimira), Kanheri Caves, Upvan Lake.
